q: The topological entropy of the full shift on k symbols equals:
opts: log₂ k bits (or ln k nats depending on log base)
exp: The full shift has exactly kⁿ words of length n, so h_top = lim (1/n) log kⁿ = log k. This is also the entropy of the i.i.d. uniform measure on the shift, which is the unique measure of maximal entropy.
